en.summary: Neverway is the debut game from Vancouver studio Coldblood Inc., a horror life-sim RPG releasing October 2026 on PC (Windows/macOS/Linux) and Nintendo Switch. Players control Fiona, a woman who quits her dead-end job to start over on a remote island farm, only to become the immortal herald of a dead god as a nightmare reality called Neverway begins leaking into the world around her.

guideSections.title: Farming by Day, Horror by Night
guideSections.description: Neverway deliberately refuses to treat its life-sim and horror halves as separate modes: farming, fishing, and building friendships with the island's residents sit alongside fast-paced action-RPG combat and a slow-burn psychological horror story, with the two systems feeding into each other rather than being switched between.

guideSections.title: Art & Music Pedigree
guideSections.description: The pixel art comes from Pedro Medeiros (Celeste, TowerFall) and the score from Disasterpeace (Fez, Hyper Light Drifter); a free prologue is already available on Steam ahead of the full release, giving players a first look at the game's tone before launch.
